headline: Waleetle Best Build
title: Waleetle Build | Sandstorm Spin setup | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Waleetle is an Earth rolling attacker in Aniimo. Use Stone Ball Drift first, because every hit adds damage and it stacks up to four times. Then switch to Sandstorm Spin, which hits harder on Break targets and spins faster over time. It keeps draining EP while you spin, so bring a teammate who restores EP. Finish with Rock Ball Blast. Do you main Waleetle? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Waleetle build: stack Stone Ball Drift, spin with Sandstorm Spin on Break targets, manage EP and finish with Rock Ball Blast.
